answer_b_new_export_precheck.result: CANNOT change routing, CANNOT reach in-process rav1d for an untrusted source, does NOT skip the worker for Preview
evidence: video.rs:433-435: `chosen` is computed by choose(route, video.codec) BEFORE the new block and consumed unchanged by `match chosen` at :455-479 (InProcess arm :456-463, External arm :464-478). The new block (:452-454) is `if req.purpose == Purpose::Export { require_exact_track_start(video.track, req)?; }`; its helper takes only (track, req) (isobmff.rs:1941-1944), receives no route or trust, and its Ok value is discarded, so the only effect it can have is an early Err. Chosen::InProcess has no other constructor.

Error order before it is unchanged: CodecUnavailable when choose is None (:433), video.unsupported (:436), content.refusal (:439), parse_av1c (:443). An untrusted AV1 source with no usable external decoder is therefore still CodecUnavailable (PLR-033 policy), never NotExact.

Preview: the guard is `req.purpose == Purpose::Export` (Purpose has only Preview and Export, model.rs:130-134), so a Preview opens its session exactly as before; the new test asserts it (tests/video_route.rs:955 `(opens(), chunks) == (1, 1)` for a Preview of an unaligned start).

Export at a whole-frame start still opens its session (video_route.rs:958-962, opens == 2 after the preview). deliver_packets repeats the same check (isobmff.rs:1978) through the same helper, so the pre-check and the later check cannot disagree.

External worker route: reel-native decode_av1 clones req with its purpose into IsobmffProvider/MatroskaProvider::decode_segment_routed under VideoRoute::untrusted().with_external(&tracked) (host.rs:1021-1030); a refused export now never calls tracked.open, so no worker is checked out. reel-native src and tests contain no Purpose::Export or NotExact (git grep), so no test there depends on the old order; tests/av1_worker.rs:94 builds Preview.

answer_c_new_error_paths.mxf_corrupt_mxf_temporal_offset: mxf/provider.rs:200-205 is inside the packet pre-pass of decode_packets. A Decoded request returns CodecUnavailable at :81-85, before the pre-pass is reached, and MxfProvider does not override decode_segment_routed (default impl ignores the route, model.rs:400-409). It is not reachable for a decoded video request and cannot touch AV1.
answer_c_new_error_paths.isobmff_per_track_elst_zero_duration: build_index (isobmff.rs:1644-1658) turns Unsupported elst-zero-duration of finish_track into track.unsupported = Some(..) with edits and presented cleared. Every isobmff delivery path reaches a track through select_track (isobmff.rs:1705-1716, called at :1871 for decode_segment_routed, decode_packets and the cached path) and probe (:1756) and seek (:420) also refuse, so a refused track returns Unsupported BEFORE choose(), Forward or any session open; a refused AV1 video track can neither reach rav1d nor the worker. Only build_index sets the field (:1655), so Matroska tracks (TrackIndex::new / track_from_tables set None, :325, :1276) are unaffected.
answer_c_new_error_paths.behaviour_shift_not_a_trust_issue: registry.rs proxy_usable (:296-313) uses provider.probe. Before 0474906 a zero-duration edit on ANY track made the proxy's index fail, so a proxy was dropped (ProxyUnusableUsedOriginal) and the original was decoded under the caller's `trust`. Now probe fails only when the DEFAULT track is the refused one, so a proxy whose non-default track is refused stays usable and then decodes under its OWN proxy_trust (registry.rs:265-268). This can only move decoding from the original's route to the proxy's own route, never raises a trust, and PLR-033 holds in both orders. Reading only; no test pins the shift (not searched beyond the files listed in method).
